import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        new Main().run();
    }

    public void run() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        System.out.println(f(n));
    }

    long f(long n) {
        int Len = (int) 4e5;
        long[] pi_upper = new long[Len];
        long[] pi_lower = new long[Len];
        int i = 1;
        while (i < Len) {
            pi_lower[i] = i;
            pi_upper[i] = n / i;
            i++;
        }
        boolean[] isPrime = new boolean[Len];
        for (int j = 0; j < Len; j++) isPrime[j] = true;
        isPrime[0] = false;
        isPrime[1] = false;
        int[] primeList = new int[Len];
        int primeCount = 0;
        for (int p = 2; p < Len; p++) {
            if (!isPrime[p]) continue;
            primeList[primeCount++] = p;
            for (int j = p * 2; j < Len; j += p) {
                isPrime[j] = false;
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < primeCount; t++) {
            int p = primeList[t];
            long p2 = (long) p * p;
            for (int idx = 1; idx < Len && n / idx >= p2; idx++) {
                long key = (long) p * idx;
                if (key < Len) {
                    pi_upper[idx] -= pi_upper[(int) key] - (t + 1);
                } else {
                    pi_upper[idx] -= pi_lower[(int) (n / idx / p)] - (t + 1);
                }
            }
            for (int idx = Len - 1; idx >= p2; idx--) {
                pi_lower[idx] -= pi_lower[idx / p] - (t + 1);
            }
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < primeCount; idx++) {
            long p = primeList[idx];
            if (p * p > n) break;
            if (p * p * p <= n && p * p * p > 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            if (n / p > p) {
                if (p < Len)
                    ans += pi_upper[(int) p] - pi_lower[(int) p];
                else
                    ans += pi_lower[(int) (n / p)] - pi_lower[(int) p];
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    void tr(Object... objects) {
        System.out.println(java.util.Arrays.deepToString(objects));
    }
}
